descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92586 AC 9; UAT TC-08 ER 7 · “Copying stays on the device; nothing is emailed or shared outside the app.”. Mixed: stated part — No handoff text leaves the device during Copy; plain text like Copy to EMR; our part — Copy before the list loads and while generating; export-row metadata (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S27 Copy at its edges: before the list loads, while generating and after; the export row and the socket carry no handoff text; plain text like Copy to EMR

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 A 'Copy' button copies the current handoff text, including any edits, to the clipboard, the same as 'Copy to EMR' on the note; copying stays on the device and nothing is emailed or shared. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Sender with the S01 census and a saved note on H1 (for Copy to EMR)

When Open /rounding/handoff and tap Copy Text as soon as it can be clicked (before the patient list has loaded); reopen and tap Copy Text while 'Generating' is still showing; tap it again after generation; open H1's note and tap Copy to EMR; …

Then Recorded for Q15: what each early copy held (empty sheet, chart-template stand-ins or AI text) and the patient count its export row logged. Judged: no export row's metadata holds a patient name, task text or the copied text; no frame sent during a copy carries a patient name or task text; the handoff clipboard text is plain text with no markup. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Probe assertions on the export audit rows (read as e2e/export.spec.ts does) and on websocket framesent payloads: none contains '{hospitalPatient}', '{hospitalPatient2}', '{hospitalPatient3}', 'QA-H1-7731' or 'Follow up blood cultures'. The clipboard text contains none of '<p', '<br', '<li', '**', '##', '<', ' '. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
